application_sentences: Hegewald & Peschke offers a large portfolio of testing technology, which also includes various devices for testing wires.
In addition, Hegewald & Peschke offers a series of torsion testing devices that can be used for simple as well as highly complex torsion tests up to 5000Nm.
The light version of the length measuring machine can be used for measuring precision steel pipes up to 3850 mm measuring length with different pipe diameters.

dwich elements according to DIN EN 14509 Testing machine for bending test, compression test and tensile test according to DIN EN 14509 Sandwich elements can be used for a wide range of applications and are particularly suitable for the rapid construction of industrial buildings, for example.
The testing systems are suitable for wires of various dimensions and materials, from fine wire to high-strength wire alloys.
Designed for efficient daily laboratory operation, the test benches offer quick and secure sample mounting.
In addition to PLC-operated test benches specifically designed for defined standard tests, flexible twist tests without tensile load can be performed on software-based torsion test benches.
